entities.summary: Pepita Laguarda Batet (1919–1936), was a teenage Catalan girl and anarchist militia member who fought on the Aragon front during the Spanish Civil War. She was incorporated into the libertarian ranks without having yet reached adulthood and died in Uesca at the age of seventeen. She was the youngest soldier to die in combat during the war.
